fields.name: gold
fields.coerce: `max(1, min(parseInt(gold) || 0, 1000000000))`: a string works, a fraction goes away
fields.description: The gold to give to the gold pool of the server (`S.gold`).

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Any truthy value. The server then also checks that you are near Lost and Found, and the replies are objects with `request_id`.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. The server moves the gold to `S.gold`. The code depends on the amount (the same rule in both forms): `donate_thx` for 1,000,000 or more, `donate_gum` for 100,000 to 999,999, `donate_low` for less than 100,000.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code: `donate_thx`: 1,000,000 or more; it sets `player.donation`, which opens Lost and Found until you log out. `donate_gum`: 100,000 to 999,999; you get a `gum`. `donate_low`: less than 100,000.

fields.name: xprate
fields.description: The XP that a merchant gets for each gold: 4.8 while `S.gold` (before this donation) is below 500,000,000, 4 up to 1,000,000,000, else 3.2. Other classes get no XP.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code: `donate_thx`: 1,000,000 or more; it sets `player.donation`, which opens Lost and Found until you log out. `donate_gum`: 100,000 to 999,999; you get a `gum`. `donate_low`: less than 100,000.

fields.name: xprate
fields.description: The XP that a merchant gets for each gold: 4.8 while `S.gold` (before this donation) is below 500,000,000, 4 up to 1,000,000,000, else 3.2. Other classes get no XP.

rows.when: No character, or the character is in the bank.
With `request_id` only: you are more than 500 px from the `lostandfound` NPC on `woffice`.
The amount is more than your gold.

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`: less `gold`, more `xp` for a merchant, and the `gum` in `items` for `donate_gum`.
